## Modules

- [LiveSvelte](https://live-svelte.hexdocs.pm/LiveSvelte.md): 
- [LiveSvelte.Components](https://live-svelte.hexdocs.pm/LiveSvelte.Components.md): Macros to improve the developer experience of crossing the Liveview/Svelte boundary.

- [LiveSvelte.Encoder](https://live-svelte.hexdocs.pm/LiveSvelte.Encoder.md): Protocol for encoding values for LiveSvelte JSON serialization.
- [LiveSvelte.JSON](https://live-svelte.hexdocs.pm/LiveSvelte.JSON.md): JSON encoding using Erlang/OTP 27's native :json module.
- [LiveSvelte.Reload](https://live-svelte.hexdocs.pm/LiveSvelte.Reload.md): Utilities for easier integration with Vite in development.

- [LiveSvelte.SSR](https://live-svelte.hexdocs.pm/LiveSvelte.SSR.md): A behaviour for rendering Svelte components server-side.
- [LiveSvelte.SSR.ViteJS](https://live-svelte.hexdocs.pm/LiveSvelte.SSR.ViteJS.md): Implements SSR by making a POST request to `http://{:vite_host}/ssr_render`.
- [LiveSvelte.Test](https://live-svelte.hexdocs.pm/LiveSvelte.Test.md): Helpers for testing LiveSvelte components and views.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix live_svelte.install](https://live-svelte.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.LiveSvelte.Install.md): Installer for LiveSvelte with Vite.
